heroHeadline: USMCA Rupture: Canada-US Deal Still Unsigned as Section 338 Deadline Hits Midnight
heroSubtitle: LeBlanc and Greer resumed talks in Washington Friday with the Aug 19 tariff pause expiring 12:01am ET Saturday; steel/aluminum (25%) and auto (15%) terms are reportedly close to final, but softwood lumber and agriculture remain unresolved. Mexico is now pressing for comparable relief after a Jul 24 Section 301 forced-labor tariff put its floated 10% rate into effect.
